====================
server function with update body
====================

CREATE SERVER FUNCTION reference_mutation_test.update_false(p_entry REF reference_mutation_test.entry)
RETURNS ROWS (updated REF reference_mutation_test.entry)
SECURITY INVOKER TRANSACTION ATOMIC VOLATILITY VOLATILE
AS UPDATE reference_mutation_test.entry AS alias
SET stored = FALSE
WHERE REF(alias) = p_entry
RETURNING REF(alias);

====================
server function with delete body
====================

CREATE SERVER FUNCTION reference_mutation_test.delete_entry(p_entry REF reference_mutation_test.entry)
RETURNS ROWS (deleted BOOLEAN)
SECURITY INVOKER TRANSACTION ATOMIC VOLATILITY VOLATILE
AS DELETE FROM reference_mutation_test.entry AS alias
WHERE REF(alias) = p_entry
RETURNING TRUE;
